notes: 70/30 PROC SURVEYSELECT train/test split, PROC LOGISTIC predicting Cirrhosis from 16 clinical/biochemical predictors with a CLASS(ref=) Gender effect, and a PROC SGPLOT ROC curve. Original read a SAS-Studio-uploaded nafld.csv via FILENAME REFFILE and called %web_drop_table/%web_open_table session helpers; its predictor list also used named-literal columns ("Systolic Blood Pressure"n etc.) from an earlier, unshipped nafld.csv rather than this repo's actual NAFLD_imputed.csv column names. Replaced with inline DATALINES (all 24 Cirrhosis=1 patients + 40 sampled Cirrhosis=0 patients from this repo's own NAFLD_imputed.csv) and retargeted predictor names to the shipped CSV's columns (SBP, DBP, Diyabetes, TotalCholesterol). The original's `ods output ROCcurve=rocdata` had no PLOTS=ROC/ROC statement/OUTROC= to actually populate it -- a bug in the student's own script, not touched here since it wouldn't have worked under real SAS either -- so this bundle adds PLOTS=ROC to PROC LOGISTIC and gets the curve points into rocdata via the MODEL statement's documented OUTROC= option instead.
